about_the_game: With all the base towers and upgrade paths to tier 2, 10 waves and 2 bosses and an endless mode this demo has roughly 30 minutes to 1 hour of content. Dip your toe into Tower Defense Classic I today!
detailed_description: With all the base towers and upgrade paths to tier 2, 10 waves and 2 bosses and an endless mode this demo has roughly 30 minutes to 1 hour of content. Dip your toe into Tower Defense Classic I today!
name: Tower Defense Classic I Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: 2.0ghz (x86-64)
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 compatible, ATI, Nvidia or Intel HD
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: 2.5ghz or better (x86-64)
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 compatible, ATI, Nvidia or Intel HD
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible sound card
